smoke.purpose: Exercise every physical channel, checkpoint, and aggregation path without changing paper-scale declarations.

unpublished_inputs: exact p meshes outside printed labels

review_policy.forbidden_response: Do not tune physical parameters or numerical arrays merely to move a stable mismatch toward the paper.
